title: Juicy Peppery Saudi Arabian Lamb Stew
description: A peppery and creamy one-pot Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, light rum, and traditional spices, cooked to perfection on a tava griddle. This Whole30-friendly stew is perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Heat the tava griddle over medium-high heat and add the lamb cubes, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the light rum, black peppercorns, ground cumin, paprika, and salt to the griddle, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the coconut cream and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
